purpose: Unqualified as-is WIP preservation; not an integrated or tested release.
layout: First commit captures original workspace modifications, additions and deletions. Second commit adds frozen candidate as a separate source directory without replacing first-commit sources.
exclusionPolicy: Secrets, credential files, .env* and grants are not copied; no credentials exported or activated.
Runtime data/media/models, build outputs, dependency caches and generated run/report directories are omitted.
Files over20MiB and unknown binary outputs are omitted; source patches and licensed source assets are retained.
Known synthetic credential literals in four existing tests were reviewed and retained; no real credential matches found.
Existing ancestor history is retained, not rewritten. Existing source-controlled assets and fixtures in that ancestor remain there.
